text.tspan: Raspberry Pi 4 • BCM numbering • 3.3 V logic
Bits 7–4: per-radio band mapping. Bits 3–0: per-radio display policy.
All logic is 3.3 V. Never apply 5 V to GPIO, I²C,
Use either display variant shown on page 2 — not both.
GPIO 17 / pin 11 → relay module IN (active HIGH)
GPIO 26 / pin 37 → resistor* → Bluetooth LED → GND
Relay control side is powered by the Pi; contacts switch the separate 12 V supply.
